template<typename U, typename V>
struct Pair {
    U first;
    V second;
    
    Pair(U f, V s) : first(f), second(s) {}
    
    static Pair<U, V> makePair(U f, V s) {
        return Pair<U, V>(f, s);
    }
    
    bool operator==(const Pair<U, V>& other) const {
        return first == other.first && second == other.second;
    }
    
    bool operator<(const Pair<U, V>& other) const {
        if (first != other.first) return first < other.first;
        return second < other.second;
    }
};

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& stream;
    vector<char> buf;
    int curChar;
    int numChars;
    
public:
    InputReader(istream& s) : stream(s), buf(1024), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}
    
    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) {
            throw runtime_error("Input mismatch exception");
        }
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }
    
    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
            c = read();
        }
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw runtime_error("Input mismatch exception");
            }
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
    
    string readString() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
            c = read();
        }
        string res;
        do {
            if (c >= 0 && c < 128) {
                res += (char)c;
            }
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res;
    }
    
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class Graph {
public:
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<ll> weight;
    vector<ll> capacity;
    vector<int> nextOutbound;
    vector<int> flags;
    
    Graph(int n) : vertexCount(n), edgeCount(0) {
        firstOutbound.resize(n, -1);
    }
    
    Graph(int n, int edgeCapacity) : vertexCount(n), edgeCount(0) {
        firstOutbound.resize(n, -1);
        from.resize(edgeCapacity);
        to.resize(edgeCapacity);
        nextOutbound.resize(edgeCapacity);
        flags.resize(edgeCapacity, 0);
    }
    
    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, ll w, ll cap, int rev) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1) {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        } else {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        }
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;
        from[edgeCount] = fromID;
        to[edgeCount] = toID;
        if (cap != 0) {
            if (capacity.empty()) {
                capacity.resize(from.size(), 0);
            }
            capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
        }
        if (w != 0) {
            if (weight.empty()) {
                weight.resize(from.size(), 0);
            }
            weight[edgeCount] = w;
        }
        if (rev != -1) {
            // We don't use reverseEdge in this implementation
        }
        return edgeCount++;
    }
    
    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, ll w, ll cap) {
        if (cap == 0) {
            return addEdge(from, to, w, 0, -1);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeCount = edgeCount;
            addEdge(to, from, -w, 0, -1);
            return addEdge(from, to, w, cap, lastEdgeCount);
        }
    }
    
    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        if (from.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)from.size());
            from.resize(newSize);
            to.resize(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            flags.resize(newSize, 0);
            if (!weight.empty()) weight.resize(newSize);
            if (!capacity.empty()) capacity.resize(newSize);
        }
    }
    
    int firstOutbound(int vertex) {
        int id = firstOutbound[vertex];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }
    
    int nextOutbound(int id) {
        id = nextOutbound[id];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }
    
    int source(int id) {
        return from[id];
    }
    
    int destination(int id) {
        return to[id];
    }
    
    ll weight(int id) {
        if (weight.empty()) return 0;
        return weight[id];
    }
    
    ll capacity(int id) {
        if (capacity.empty()) return 0;
        return capacity[id];
    }
    
    bool isRemoved(int id) {
        return (flags[id] >> 0 & 1) != 0;
    }
    
    void pushFlow(int id, ll flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return;
        capacity[id] -= flow;
        // Note: In original code, reverseEdge is used but not implemented here
        // This is a simplified version
    }
};

class MinCostFlow {
private:
    Graph& graph;
    int source;
    int destination;
    vector<ll> phi;
    vector<ll> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex;
    int vertexCount;
    
public:
    MinCostFlow(Graph& g, int s, int d, bool hasNegativeEdges) 
        : graph(g), source(s), destination(d), vertexCount(g.vertexCount) {
        phi.resize(vertexCount, 0);
        dijkstraResult.resize(vertexCount, LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge.resize(vertexCount, -1);
        visited.resize(vertexCount, 0);
        visitIndex = 0;
        
        if (hasNegativeEdges) {
            fordBellman();
        }
    }
    
    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[source] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(vertexCount, false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int stepCount = 0;
        int maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int vertex = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(vertex);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    ll total = phi[vertex] + graph.weight(edgeID);
                    int dest = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (phi[dest] > total) {
                        phi[dest] = total;
                        if (!inQueue[dest]) {
                            q.push(dest);
                            inQueue[dest] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw runtime_error("Graph contains negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }
    
    static PLL minCostMaxFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int destination, bool hasNegativeEdges, ll maxFlow) {
        return MinCostFlow(graph, source, destination, hasNegativeEdges).minCostMaxFlow(maxFlow);
    }
    
    PLL minCostMaxFlow(ll maxFlow) {
        ll cost = 0;
        ll flow = 0;
        
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            dijkstraAlgorithm();
            
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return make_pair(cost, flow);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            
            int vertex = destination;
            ll currentFlow = maxFlow;
            ll currentCost = 0;
            
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph.capacity(edgeID));
                currentCost += graph.weight(edgeID);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
            
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
        }
        
        return make_pair(cost, flow);
    }
    
private:
    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        
        priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, greater<pair<ll, int>>> pq;
        pq.push({0, source});
        
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [dist, current] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            
            if (dist > dijkstraResult[current]) continue;
            
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(current);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    ll total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        pq.push({total, next});
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

    vector<int> ugliness(n);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        ugliness[i] = -in.readInt();
    }
    
    int graphSize = 1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1;
    Graph graph(graphSize);
    
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            int cost = 0;
            if (c == s[i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
            }
            if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
            }
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, cost, 1);
        }
    }
    
    vector<int> occurs(128, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        occurs[(unsigned char)s[i]]++;
    }
    
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
        graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(0, 1 + (c - 'a'), 0, occurs[c]);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n / 2, 0, 2);
    }
    
    PLL flow = MinCostFlow::minCostMaxFlow(graph, 0, 1 + 26 + n / 2, true, n);
    cout << -flow.first << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
